question: Does bounded proposal/acceptance tracing produce a useful tolerance edit with existing portable noise, and transfer to an analytic scalar field?
hypothesis: A wider permitted scalar band changes path confinement while accepted-only retention keeps storage proportional to actual movement.

baseline.renderer: Java2D BufferedImage private experiment, not Processing acceptance

comparison: Fixed starts, per-path proposal seeds, field and style; inspect both renders and changed pixels. Separate radial-field transfer is a design test.
constraints: 96 walkers,2048 attempts each,640x640; three images total.
Four random draws per attempt; rejection changes heading only.
No public default or encouraged continuous range inferred.
Run under shared machine lease; artifacts remain ignored.
decision_rule: Continue toward admission only if both noise runs yield recognizable connected band-constrained strokes, the tolerance edit is visible, and radial transfer works with the same traversal. Record runtimes/accepted counts/memory; no universal runtime threshold. If sparse or immobile, diagnose one concrete cause before proposing another bounded experiment.
implementation: Private independently specified Java prototype by Terra; existing GradientNoise2D01 replaces host noise; explicit xorshift32 and separate style/start streams replace Processing RNG.
runtime: OpenJDK17.0.20.1, StrictMath sin/cos/hypot; Java2D BufferedImage; not Processing acceptance

results.root_observation: Long thin winding lines and nested loop-like bands, with occasional dense small scribbles.
Thicker tangled strokes cluster along related bands; visible extent and path trajectories change.
Concentric arcs at different radii, including some loop-like paths; no closed-loop guarantee.

limits: Reported storage counts coordinate payload only; excludes objects, starts and temporary/replay arrays.
Timings are single observations without controlled warmup or benchmark repetitions.
Prototype renderer rounds positions to integer pixels and omits the segment from each original start to first acceptance; final public path must include its start.
Private xorshift stream and field callback are not the future public RNG or API.
Radial changes field family and is only a design transfer test, not a tolerance comparison.
